name: Stonecreek Village Shopping Center
summary: Stonecreek Village Shopping Center is a community-focused retail destination on Pacific Avenue in Stockton, offering convenient access to diverse shopping, dining, and services. With extended hours and a strong customer rating, it serves as a reliable hub for everyday needs in the greater Stockton area.
demographics: Stonecreek Village Shopping Center serves a diverse middle-income demographic in Stockton, California, with a primary trade area consisting of families and working professionals aged 25-54. The center attracts shoppers from surrounding residential neighborhoods seeking convenient access to everyday necessities and services. Typical visitors include dual-income households with moderate to middle-income levels who value one-stop shopping for groceries, dining, and essential retail needs. The shopping patterns reflect a community-oriented customer base that frequents the center for regular weekly shopping trips rather than destination retail experiences.
description: Stonecreek Village Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination located at 5757 Pacific Avenue in Stockton, California. This open-air retail center serves as a convenient hub for local residents, offering a diverse mix of retailers, dining options, and essential services that cater to everyday shopping needs. With its accessible location along Pacific Avenue, one of Stockton's major commercial corridors, the center provides ample parking and easy access for shoppers throughout the greater Stockton area. The shopping center maintains extended operating hours from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM, accommodating busy schedules and providing flexibility for customers to shop at their convenience. With a strong 4.3-star rating from over 1,400 reviews, Stonecreek Village has established itself as a trusted and popular shopping destination that consistently meets the needs of the local community.
